cues: An application is a covering letter, in four paragraphs.
The post, and where and when you saw it advertised.
Your single most relevant qualification, with the year and the board.
What you have actually done: an internship, tuition you taught, software you can use.
And a close offering yourself for interview and naming the enclosures.
It does not repeat the C V; it points to the two facts in it that matter for this post.
